newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer Capital Growth Fund manager resigns.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer Capital Growth Fund manager resigns.

text.p: Pioneer Funds Friday said one of its best-known mutual fund managers, Warren Isabelle, who headed the $2.2 billion Pioneer Capital Growth Fund, resigned this week.

"We don't know what his plans are or what prompted this sudden move," said Anne Patenaude, a spokeswoman for Pioneer. "We're very surprised and sorry to see him go. We've been very pleased with his performance."
His departure was effective immediately, she said.
Isabelle also managed the $510 million Pioneer Small Company Fund from its inception in November 1995 until a few weeks ago, when he gave it up to concentrate on the Capital Growth Fund, she said.
Patenaude said the Pioneer funds were run by a committee with one fund manager assuming overall responsibility.
"Our people that have been part of that team for several years are continuing to run that fund. The fund will continue to be run as an aggressive value fund," she said.
Isabelle was not immediately available for comment.
